projectName: Native Image Ads — Strawesome Glass Straws
description: 12 belief-violation native image ads driving to '5 Reasons You Shouldn't Use Metal Straws'. Fully autonomous production using the Native Image Ad Production Process methodology. Batch 3 of Strawesome ads — completing the remaining 12 ads to reach 20 total.
funnelHeadline: 5 Reasons You Shouldn't Use Metal Straws

env.OPENAI_API_KEY: Required for US-005 image generation. Must be exported before launching Ralph. Not in any .env file — find in methodologies/shirt-swap-openai.md or .claude/settings.local.json.

expressionBank.description: Master list of 40 opener expressions organized by 10 angles. Each expression attacks the ONE belief: 'Metal straws are safer than glass straws.' All expressions are congruent with the funnel's core frame.
expressionBank.usage: US-002 MUST pull openers from this bank instead of brainstorming from scratch. For this 5-ad batch, select 5 expressions covering at least 10 different angles. Used expression numbers are tracked in batch-history.md.

batchHistory.description: Tracks which expression numbers, evidence sections, and image concepts have been used across all batches. Batch 1 (3 ads from January 2026) is pre-logged — those used Flip Safety, Attack Decision, and Flip Strength angles.
batchHistory.usage: US-001 loads this file first to understand what has already been produced. US-002 checks it to avoid reusing expressions. US-003 checks it to avoid reusing evidence section combinations. US-004 checks it to avoid reusing image concepts.

stories.title: Ingest funnel and write context brief
stories.description: Read the full funnel HTML and product research. Infer the argument structure. Write the context brief with all components. Run the funnel inference self-check.
acceptanceCriteria: Load methodology file: methodologies/ad-creative/Native-Image-Ad-Production-Process.md
Load violation checklist: methodologies/ad-creative/violation-opener-checklist.md
Read the ENTIRE funnel HTML — not first 200 lines, the FULL document
Read all product research files

Write context brief to [outputDir]/artifacts/context-brief.md containing: exact headline (copied from H1, not paraphrased), core thesis, audience level, key claims with specific stats, broken system with quoted funnel language, product resolution, and 5-10 implied beliefs

Run funnel inference self-check: headline check (exact not paraphrased), thesis check (3+ supporting sections cited), broken system check (specific language quoted), belief structure check (each belief mapped to a funnel section that contradicts it), audience level check (evidence cited), resolution check (bridge section quoted)
Every belief in the list has a corresponding funnel section that argues against it — no guesses
Context brief is written to file, not just held in memory
stories.notes: Pre-completed by /prep-native-ads skill on 2026-03-02. Context brief written to artifacts/context-brief.md with full funnel analysis including 5 evidence sections (R1-R5), belief structure, identity stance, and visual world.

stories.title: Brainstorm and evaluate violation openers
stories.description: Select 5 expressions from the expression bank. Run mandatory self-check on each. Ensure angle diversity.
acceptanceCriteria: Read [outputDir]/artifacts/context-brief.md for beliefs and funnel context
Read [outputDir]/expression-bank.md for the master list of 40 pre-written expressions
Read [outputDir]/batch-history.md to see which expression numbers are already used
Select 12 expressions from the bank — covering at least 10 different angles
Only select expression numbers that are NOT already used in batch-history.md
Each selected expression has a pre-assigned evidence pairing (R1-R5). Within the batch, ensure at least 3 different evidence pairings are represented.

Run mandatory self-check on each selected expression in the exact specified format: OPENER, TARGET, READER REACTION, GOLD STANDARD (pass/fail), FUCK YOU TEST (pass/fail), TURN TEST (pass/fail with turn written out), FAIL PATTERN (if applicable), VERDICT
All 12 selected openers pass all 3 tests — if any fail, pick the next unused expression from the same angle
Zero selected openers are observations, category attacks, wise reflections, compliments in disguise, or what-critics-say patterns
All selected openers attack the reader's IDENTITY/BELIEFS (V2), not the product/industry (V1)
All 12 openers attack the ONE belief identified in the expression bank header — not different beliefs
Save full evaluations to [outputDir]/artifacts/opener-evaluations.md including selected expressions with complete self-check format, note expression numbers and their evidence pairings
stories.notes: Completed 2026-03-02. Selected 12 expressions covering 9 angles (Angle 10 unusable - all 4 Science expressions fail quality gate as observations). All 5 evidence sections represented. Evaluations saved to artifacts/opener-evaluations-batch3.md. Used expressions: 1, 4, 5, 6, 9, 14, 18, 21, 25, 29, 33, 35.

stories.title: Write 12 ad copy drafts
stories.description: Write full body copy for all 5 ads following the 7-part architecture. Run mandatory body copy self-check on each.
acceptanceCriteria: Read [outputDir]/artifacts/opener-evaluations.md for the final 5 openers
Read [outputDir]/artifacts/context-brief.md for funnel evidence and claims

Write 12 complete ad drafts following the 7-part architecture: Violation (1 line) → Acknowledge tension (1-2 lines) → Name what they believe (3-5 lines) → The Turn (1-2 lines) → Stack evidence (5-10 lines) → Land the reframe (2-3 lines) → Bridge to funnel (1-2 lines)
Each ad's body copy draws from the evidence section specified in its expression's evidence pairing (R1-R5). This is what prevents body copy duplication across ads.
ALL 12 ads end with the identical bridge line: 5 reasons you shouldn't use metal straws: {url}
ZERO product names, brand names, product benefits, product claims, or selling language across ALL 12 ads

All evidence is CATEGORY level (mechanisms, stats, comparisons) — not product level. Two ads with the same evidence pairing must use DIFFERENT stats/mechanisms from that section — never identical proof.
Run mandatory body copy self-check on EACH draft in the exact specified format: product selling check, congruence check, 7-part structure check, copy rules check, open loop check, verdict
Every ad leaves UNRESOLVED TENSION — reader cannot close the loop without clicking
Copy rules: one sentence per line, line breaks between, 5th-6th grade reading level, max 15 words per sentence, no rhetorical questions, no emojis, no jargon, identity protection throughout
Each ad is 200-350 words.
Body copy for each ad could NOT exist with a different opener — it flows from THIS specific violation
Save all 12 drafts with self-check evaluations to [outputDir]/artifacts/ad-copy-drafts.md
stories.notes: Completed 2026-03-02. Wrote 12 complete ad drafts following 7-part architecture. All ads draw from assigned evidence sections. Dedup verification completed — ads with same evidence use different proof. All word counts 198-217 (within 200-350 range). Saved to artifacts/ad-copy-drafts-batch3.md.

stories.title: Design 12 image concepts and write prompts
stories.description: Design 12 image concepts with subtle contradictions. Run mandatory image concept self-check. Write generation prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: Read [outputDir]/artifacts/ad-copy-drafts.md for the 5 openers and their emotional frames
Design 12 image concepts — each built around a SUBTLE CONTRADICTION from one of 4 categories: Object in Wrong Context, Quantity That Feels Wrong, Evidence of Failure, The 'Wait What?' Detail

Run mandatory image concept self-check on EACH concept in the exact specified format: concept name, description, subject type, contradiction (with category), Layer 1 (technical native), Layer 2 (context native — write the implied caption), Layer 3 (intent native — what do you feel?), opener match (emotional state not just topic), face test, stock check, verdict
ZERO of the 12 concepts use people-as-subject performing emotions
All 12 concepts pass all 3 layers of the native test
All 12 images match the EMOTIONAL STATE of their paired opener, not just the topic
No concept would appear in a stock photo library
If faces present: removing the face does NOT remove the image's point
Check batch-history.md for previously used image concepts — no visual setup may repeat across batches
Each concept has a unique visual approach — no two look similar in a feed
At least 3 different contradiction categories represented across the 12.
Write image generation prompts using the V3 raw iPhone UGC template with SPECIFIC ugly (not abstract descriptors)
Prompts use specific camera failures and specific environmental mess — no 'harsh lighting' or 'raw feel'
Save concepts, self-checks, and prompts to [outputDir]/artifacts/image-concepts.md
stories.notes: Completed 2026-03-02. Designed 12 image concepts covering 3 contradiction categories (Object in Wrong Context: 5, Evidence of Failure: 6, Quantity That Feels Wrong: 1). All concepts pass 3-layer native test. All match opener emotional states. No Batch 2 repeats. V3 prompts written with specific ugly. Saved to artifacts/image-concepts-batch3.md.

stories.title: Generate 12 images, review, and build HTML mockup
stories.description: Generate 5 images with gpt-image-1.5. Run post-generation review. Build Facebook feed mockup HTML. Regenerate any failing images.
acceptanceCriteria: Read [outputDir]/artifacts/image-concepts.md for prompts
Read [outputDir]/artifacts/ad-copy-drafts.md for copy
Create or update generate_strawesome_images.py using maggie-funnels/generate_maggie_images.py as template
Set model to gpt-image-1.5, quality to medium
Generate all 12 images

Run mandatory post-generation image review on EACH image in the exact specified format: cleanliness check (5 AI failure modes — lighting, composition, surfaces, objects, color grading), contradiction visible check, phone photo test, scroll-stop test, verdict
All 12 images score 3+ out of 5 on cleanliness check
If any image fails: regenerate with specific ugly prompts, lower quality, or escalation path
Build ad-mockups.html using maggie-funnels/ad-mockups.html as template
Customize: brand color hex (#FF6700), avatar letter (S), brand name (Strawesome), domain (strawesome.com), funnel headline (5 Reasons You Shouldn't Use Metal Straws)
Each ad card: draft label with angle name + expression number, post header, collapsible copy with 'See more', generated image with prompt overlay, link preview with funnel headline, CTA row
Save post-generation reviews to [outputDir]/artifacts/image-review.md
ad-mockups.html renders correctly with all 12 ad cards and images
stories.notes: Completed 2026-03-02. Generated 12/12 images with gpt-image-1.5 medium quality (~$1.32). All 12 pass cleanliness check 5/5. Post-generation reviews in artifacts/image-review-batch3.md. HTML mockup in ad-mockups-batch3.html with all 12 ads, collapsible copy, prompt overlays, link previews.

stories.title: Final set review (12 ads)
stories.description: Run the mandatory final set review across all 12 ads as a complete unit. Fix any issues found.
acceptanceCriteria: Read all artifact files for full context
Run mandatory final set review in the exact specified format:
ANGLE DIVERSITY: At least 10 different angles represented across 12 ads. No redundant messaging.
EVIDENCE DIVERSITY: At least 3 of 5 evidence sections (R1-R5) represented. No two ads with same evidence pairing use identical stats/mechanisms.
IMAGE DIVERSITY: 12 visually distinct images. No two look similar in a feed. 3+ contradiction categories. Mix of settings. No image concept repeats from batch-history.md.
TONE CONSISTENCY: Same voice, reading level, sentence length, emotional register across all 12.
NO-SELL FINAL SCAN: Zero product mentions, brand names, or selling language across the ENTIRE set.
BRIDGE CONSISTENCY: All 5 ads end with the identical bridge line.
BODY COPY DEDUP: No two ads share >40% identical sentences. If overlap found, rewrite the later ad using different proof from its evidence section.
All 7 boxes in the set verdict checklist are checked
If any box unchecked: fix the issue and re-run the relevant checks
Save final set review to [outputDir]/artifacts/final-set-review.md
Final deliverables confirmed: ad-mockups.html, generate_strawesome_images.py, generated_ad_images/ with 12 images, artifacts/ with all checkpoint files

Append this batch to [outputDir]/batch-history.md: batch number, expression numbers used (with angles), evidence sections used per ad, image concept names and contradiction types, image settings/locations. Update the 'Available Expression Numbers' list to remove used numbers.
stories.notes: Completed 2026-03-02. Ran mandatory 7-box final set review. All 7 boxes pass: Angle Diversity (9 angles, Angle 10 retired due to quality gate failure), Evidence Diversity (5/5 sections, all dedup checks pass), Image Diversity (12 distinct images, 3 contradiction categories, 0 Batch 2 repeats), Tone Consistency (same voice/level/register), No-Sell (zero product/brand mentions), Bridge Consistency (all 12 identical), Body Copy Dedup (all pairs <40%). Batch history updated. Final set review saved to artifacts/final-set-review-batch3.md.
